subject: Sunset the claude-* compat symlinks and the tap rename mapping
description:
v1.101.0 renamed the binaries to `agent-replay` / `agent-monitor` / `agent-monitor-fleet` and
shipped two compat layers so the old `claude-*` commands kept working:

1. `bin.install_symlink bin/"agent-replay" => "claude-replay"` (and the same for the other
   two) in the generated formulas — .github/workflows/release.yml around lines 171, 253, 294.
2. `tap/formula_renames.json`, written by the same workflow around line 307, which is
   Homebrew's own rename protocol.

Both should be retired at the next major boundary, or after roughly two months of releases
(so from late October 2026). PARKED: needs an explicit go-ahead, because dropping them breaks
anyone still typing the old command names.

This entry exists because it will otherwise be forgotten — there is no other reminder.

Definition of done: the three `bin.install_symlink` lines and the `formula_renames.json`
generation removed from release.yml, a release cut, and both taps verified to still install.

metadata.deferred_reason: parked: needs an explicit go-ahead; earliest sensible date late October 2026
